resolved_findings.finding: Room REPLACE could cascade-delete model bindings or fail against TurnRun RESTRICT references.
resolved_findings.resolution: ProviderConnection and ModelBinding writes now use Room Upsert semantics with regression coverage.

resolved_findings.finding: TurnRun sequence allocation and state transitions were split across non-atomic repository calls.
resolved_findings.resolution: Domain and data contracts now expose transactional create, retry, and conditional completion operations.

resolved_findings.finding: Legacy Gemini profiles were mapped to OpenAI-compatible during migration.
resolved_findings.resolution: Migration recognizes both Gemini and GeminiNative and maps them to GeminiNative.

resolved_findings.finding: Sync cursor reads were not scoped by spaceId.
resolved_findings.resolution: Cursor contracts and Room queries are scoped by spaceId and entityType.

resolved_findings.finding: Session model binding had no domain persistence path.
resolved_findings.resolution: SessionRepository now provides setModelBinding and the Room implementation updates session and settings transactionally.

resolved_findings.finding: Frontend ports were synchronous while domain and data boundaries were suspendable.
resolved_findings.resolution: Frontend ports and actions are asynchronous, expose loading/error states, and avoid production runBlocking.

residual_risks: Production provider HTTP calls remain disabled; the committed provider runtime is a request-description foundation.
Python online service currently uses process-local foundation storage and does not yet provide production authentication or durable persistence.
The committed workspace pager host still requires final clean integration with the existing dirty AppShell/UI work.
Connected Room migration behavior has not been executed on an Android device or emulator.
